scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Early June, the regular seminar under the rainy season sky has ended. Today is the long-awaited day for the M1GP (M1 Grand Prix) pair announcement.

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: Now, I will announce the M1GP pairs. Please work together and do your best until the presentation day.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: My heart is pounding... Actually, I like Megumi-chan, the M1 student who entered this year. I fell in love at first sight, but as her senior, I couldn't casually talk to her.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: My heart is racing... I wonder if I can be paired with Megumi-chan. But if we do become partners, I need to show her that I'm a reliable M2 senior.

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: Megumi-san will be with... let's see, {{playerName}}-kun. Please work well together.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: What!? Really!? This isn't a dream!? I'm paired with Megumi-chan... with Megumi-chan!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai! Please take care of me♪ I don't know anything about what we need to do for M1GP, so please teach me everything!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: S-same here! Let's do our best, Megumi-chan!

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: The lab trip is at the end of July, so please create something that works by then. The presentation will be at the trip destination. That's all for today, dismissed!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: The seminar ended, and only {{playerName}} and Megumi remained in the lab. Other members quickly started preparing to go home.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Oh, that's right! {{playerName}}-senpai, please have this if you'd like♪ It's a souvenir from when I went to Nikko last weekend.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: It's yuba manju. It was so delicious that I bought some for everyone in the lab too.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: She went on another trip... Megumi-chan really loves traveling.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: Every time Megumi-chan goes on a trip, she buys souvenirs and leaves them in the secretary's office. She never misses posting on ubi-all either. She's wonderful.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Thank you! You're always going to various places.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes! I love traveling♪ I get so excited when I go to new places. Oh, but what should we create for M1GP?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Since it's free development for the lab trip, we could make an app that's useful for travel destinations, or a tool that everyone can enjoy together.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: I see~! But this is my first time developing an app, so I'm worried about what to create...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan looks anxious. As her senior, I need to show her that I'm reliable!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: What app idea will you suggest to Megumi?

options.text: An SNS app where everyone can share travel spots
A location-based place name word chain game (M1GPS)
A game where you launch rockets to Mars

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Please freely input what you want to say to Megumi at the end.
